title: reading first: the boolean-text backfill (#34973 / PR #35076) does not reach the Turso remote face — measure whether remote INTEGER boolean columns hold legacy 'true'/'false' text, and add the remote twin if so
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-A, mailbox #32588, 6966778124), from #34973 / PR #35076.

## What happens
PR #35076 converges legacy `'true'` / `'false'` text in SQLite boolean columns inside driver-sql's `initObjects`. In remote mode, `TursoDriver` runs `initObjects` itself (`turso-driver.ts:1106`), so the new step **never runs there**. Remote boolean columns are `INTEGER` (`remote-transport.ts:2944`), and `INTEGER` affinity can also hold that text.

The temporal and JSON backfills each needed a remote twin; nobody has measured whether this one does.

## Done when
A reading on a remote Turso database shows whether legacy boolean text exists and is mis-filtered (`= false` missing rows). If it is, add the remote twin of the backfill, with a pin. If not, record the evidence and close.

Grade: **p2 · domain:server**, reading first. Theme: install, upgrade and uninstall reliability (an upgrade backfill), in the #34973 family (p1). Raise it to **p1** if a real remote tenant shows mis-filtered rows. That matters for hosted, which runs remote Turso.
